text: 邮件图片如何缩小到正常尺寸163邮箱？
可以。你这个是163邮箱正文里插入的图片尺寸太大，一般直接在编辑器里就能缩小：
1. 先单击正文中的那张图片。
通常图片被选中后，四周会出现边框或几个小圆点/控制点。
2. 拖动图片右下角的控制点往左上角拉，就可以按比例缩小。
建议把图片宽度调到大约600-800px的视觉宽度，在邮件正文里会比较正常，也不容易撑满收件人的屏幕。
3. 如果单击图片后出现一个浮动菜单，找类似“图片大小/调整大小/小/中/大/原图”的选项，选“中”通常最合适。
从你截图看，现在图片已经把正文区域横向撑得比较宽。你可以先点击图片本身，不要点击图片外面的文字区域，然后看图片四个角有没有缩放点。
如果你点击图片后完全没有缩放框/尺寸选项，163网页版有时对“复制粘贴进去的图片”和“插入的图片”处理不一样。最稳的方法是：删掉这张大图→先把图片本地缩小到宽700-800px→再重新插入邮件。
如果你愿意，我也可以直接根据你这张163邮箱截图，告诉你具体应该点哪里，我可以在图上给你标出来。
问问 ChatGPT
ChatGPT也可能会犯错。请核查重要信息。

text: markkho.github.io
Mark Ho 马克·何
Cognitive Scientist 认知科学家
Home 首页

Before September 2023, I was a Faculty Fellow / Assistant Professor at NYU's Center for Data Science and a XXX-doc in the Computer Science and Psychology departments at Princeton University, where I worked with Tom Griffiths and Jonathan Cohen on developing computational theories of human problem solving. Previously, I was affiliated with the Learn and Verify Group in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences at UC Berkeley. I received my Ph.D. in Cognitive Science from Brown University, where I worked with Joseph Austerweil and Fiery Cushman on teaching and social learning. foundational research in deep RL and its interdisciplinary applications, with potential impact across sectors including business management, healthcare, transportation, energy, and manufacturing. My research so far has contributed to deep RL methods that: 1) automatically discover what to learn, 2) enable effective cooperation among multiple agents (multi-XXX RL), 3) build environment models for efficient learning, 4) follow natural language instructions and assist with large language model (LLM) and dialog system training, and 5) support interdisciplinary applications, including material discovery, dynamic pricing, tuning distributed IoT systems, and optimizing ICU treatment strategies.

text: I am looking for multiple students to work with me on Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Faculty of Computer Science, Dalhousie University, located in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada.

Our group's research focus is on enabling machines to learn through interactions and become competent in complex, dynamic, and uncertain environments. To that end, XXX work on deep reinforcement learning.

Our current topics of study within deep reinforcement learning include model-based reinforcement learning, discovering what to learn, leveraging external knowledge sources, LLMs and foundation models, off-policy learning, transfer learning, and meta-learning.

screen_text.label: Prospective Students Header & Introduction
text: Janarthanan Rajendran
Home Journey Group Publications Prospective Students Gallery

Thank XXX for your interest in working with me and sharing the joy of doing research. Our group provides an inclusive and supportive environment for XXX. I strongly encourage students from underrepresented groups in Computer Science research to apply. XXX includes, but is not limited to Dalits, Adivasis, women, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, members of racialized groups and members of sexual and gender minority groups.
感谢您对我研究工作的兴趣，以及愿意与我一同分享科研的乐趣。我们团队为每个人提供包容和支持的环境。我强烈鼓励计算机科学研究中代表不足群体的学生申请。这包括但不限于达利特人、原住民、女性、土著人民、残障人士、少数族裔群体成员以及性和性别少数群体成员。
I am looking for multiple students to work with me on Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Faculty of Computer Science, Dalhousie University, located in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada...
我正在寻找多名学生，与我一同在加拿大新斯科舍省哈利法克斯市达尔豪斯大学计算机科学学院从事深度强化学习研究...

screen_text.label: Things I Look For in a Student
text: Things I Look For in a Student
我在学生身上寻找的特质
• Intellectual curiosity. 求知欲。
• Solid foundations in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Reinforcement Learning, or demonstrated ability to acquire them.
在机器学习、深度学习和强化学习方面有扎实的基础，或展现出掌握这些知识的能力。
• Strong programming skills with hands-on experience or willingness to develop them in Deep Reinforcement Learning.
具备扎实的编程技能，并有实践经验或愿意在深度强化学习领域发展这些技能。
• Good communication (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
良好的沟通能力（包括书面和口头）及人际交往能力。
• Relevant research contributions or demonstrated potential.
相关的研究贡献或已展现的潜力。
• Commitment to fostering a XXX, supportive, and inclusive environment within the research group.
致力于在研究团队内营造一个快乐、互助且包容的环境。
screen_text.summary: List of student qualities sought by the professor.

text_visible: To prevent student-teacher divergence from exploding, the authors introduce:
